machu.title: Министерство культуры Перу · Археологический комплекс Мачу-Пикчу
machu.passage: Guide to the archaeological complex: Intiwatana is a monolithic sculpture between two enclosures atop a stepped rocky outcrop. Bingham visited in 1911 and returned the following year with an excavation team.

unesco.title: ЮНЕСКО · Историческое святилище Мачу-Пикчу
unesco.passage: Approximately 200 structures on a steep ridge, more than 2,400 metres above sea level.

pisaq.title: Министерство культуры Перу · Археологический парк Писак
pisaq.passage: The principal archaeological complex was strategically located at the entrance to the Sacred Valley, and the complex includes agricultural terraces and ceremonial buildings.

choq.title: Министерство культуры Перу · Археологический парк Чокекирао
choq.passage: The original Inca trail survives in stretches; routes approach the park via the Apurímac canyon and several archaeological sectors.

pach.title: Национальный музей археологии Перу · Храм Солнца в Пачакамаке
pach.passage: The Incas took Pachacamac in about 1470, a pre-existing important sanctuary on the Peruvian coast.

ran.title: Институт археологии РАН · Сейминско-Суджинская экспедиция
ran.passage: Excavation report for the Oryol fortress. Cultural deposits there are over 3 m thick in the excavated area; lower fortress deposits contain burials; later stone footing was recorded.

fort.title: Институт археологии РАН · Дербентская экспедиция
fort.passage: Accumulated human deposits transformed the old relief at Naryn-Kala. Researchers found a later foundation cut through cultural layers.

nps.title: Служба национальных парков США · Археологическая терминология
nps.passage: Defines archaeological features, excavation units, levels, stratigraphy and baulks.

fortGloss.title: Служба национальных парков США · Полевой глоссарий форта Пуласки
fortGloss.passage: Defines archaeological feature with examples, including trash pits, foundations, postholes and hearths. A hearth is a fire spot for cooking and heating.

salado.title: Служба национальных парков США · Памятники культуры Саладо
salado.passage: Excavated rooms could have adobe-set stone walls, clay-lined hearths, postholes, storage pits and sub-floor pits.

kiva.title: Служба национальных парков США · Раскопки кивы в Большом каньоне
kiva.passage: Documented masonry rooms, storage structures and hearths. A hearth was excavated in the center of the kiva floor alongside postholes and a ventilation shaft.

early.title: Служба национальных парков США · Полуземлянки и ранние пуэбло
early.passage: Some rooms had wooden lattice plastered with mud, with large stone slabs supporting the base. Masonry overlies an earlier pithouse at the site.

zoo.title: Historic England · Зооархеология
zoo.passage: Zooarchaeology studies archaeological animal bones. Historic England maintains thousands of comparative vertebrate skeletons.

meat.title: Historic England · Кости животных из памятников неолита и раннего бронзового века
meat.passage: Chapter 4 addresses butchering, cooking and consumption of animals from archaeological remains.

bio.title: Арканзасская археологическая служба · Остеология в археологии
bio.passage: Researchers study human skeletons from archaeological sites to infer age, sex, stature, health, nutrition, disease and activity. Samples from multiple people better represent a population.

cornell.title: Корнеллский университет · Биоархеология
cornell.passage: Defines bioarchaeology as study of human remains from archaeological sites, integrating biological and cultural data. Skeletons respond to disease, malnutrition and trauma.

plants.title: Historic England · Археоботаника
plants.passage: Discusses botanical macrofossils and microfossils, charring and preservation, and the comparative seed collection.

geophys.title: Historic England · Методы археологической геофизики
geophys.passage: Magnetic variations can reveal burned iron minerals and filled ditches. Resistance instruments inject a small current through ground electrodes; moist fills and masonry often yield different responses. GPR records return time and amplitude of reflected radiofrequency pulses and can survey paved surfaces.

lidar.title: Historic England · Воздушное лазерное сканирование
lidar.passage: Pulsed airborne laser builds a terrain model and can reveal shallow features and remains under woodland.

field.title: Служба национальных парков США · Как работают археологи
field.passage: Excavation by layers to subsoil without artifacts.

dendro.title: Служба национальных парков США · Дендрохронология в Ацтекских руинах
dendro.passage: Tree cores can be obtained from archaeological beams; tree-ring widths are compared. The Aztec Ruins graph identifies two construction phases at 1111 and 1118 CE.

env.title: Historic England · Археология окружающей среды
env.passage: Technical guidance includes study of archaeological animal bones and teeth and geoarchaeology as the application of earth science to the archaeological record.

note: INITIAL preserves unsupported statements and clue-leak findings. CURRENT ties each prompt to a distinct observation and uses independent facts in option notes.
